description: USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE object-class-name-1 ONLY (ISO §2023:13.18.60.2; GR22 d)2.) — the referenced object is of EXACTLY the named class, never a subclass. LIVE since kb/Work PB389 (a trailing ONLY was a raw COBOL0307 parse error before): the descriptor carries the flag and §2023:14.9.39.3 SR12 a)1. / b)1. / c)1. read it. ONLY is §2023:8.10 context-sensitive — a legal user word at every edition — so the shape is gated only by the USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE clause's own 2002 introduction.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. UORON.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS UORONC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 C1 USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE UORONC ONLY.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE UORONC "NEW" RETURNING C1.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM UORON.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. UORONC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS UORONC.
